content: He who sits forever by the warm hearth hears no wolves, but he sees no new horizons.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Old Norse Saga Wisdom & Seafaring Precepts
explanation: Safety within the timber stockade guarantees you will not be attacked by predators in the forest. But it also guarantees your world will remain four walls wide. Greatness requires taking on the risk of the open sea and the howling wild.
practicalInsight: Step outside your comfortable routine today and tackle a challenge that genuinely stretches your boundaries.
reflectionPrompt: Where has your hunger for safe comfort made your life small, predictable, and devoid of adventure?
